notes:
POC objective: validate Dedicated pool economics + production routing behavior. Primary workload = multi-tenant chat agents + nightly embedding batch for search. Acceptance criteria: average latency <250ms tail, 95th latency <1s for 2k rps burst, overall token cost reduction >=40% vs hosted baseline.

POC scope bullets:
- Week 0 (prep): infra onboarding, VPC peering, credential exchange, security scan.
- Week 1: Canary deploy (5% traffic) to Dedicated; measure latency, error rates, KV cache hit. Basic fallback to hosted_api if error rate or latency regresses.
- Week 2: Scale canary to 30% and run stress tests (simulated peak). Enable model variant routing: primary = quantized 8-bit gpt-like open model, fallback = smaller distilled variant; verify quality delta with eval prompts.
- Week 3: Region failover test (us-east -> us-west), rollout/rollback rehearsals, cost reporting and handoff to infra.

Rollback triggers discussed and agreed: sustained error rate >2% for 5m, 95th latency >1.2s for 3m, or production-quality regressions on evaluation set. Canary auto-fallback policy: route new sessions to hosted_api or smaller variant until incident cleared.

Customer quotes: "If we can hit sub-300ms median and reduce token cost materially, we can justify reserved capacity." Finance asks for 12-month committed pricing and an option to burst. Legal: want DPA + standard SOC2 addendum. SE notes: will test prefix caching and KV lifetimes; needs support for cold-start warmers.

Open items: exact RBAC for their infra team, KMS integration pattern, egress bandwidth caps. Internal ask: prepare 2 pricing options (12mo commit, 6mo pilot) and SLOs for Dedicated POC.
